// GREEN fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the REFS slice (REF-P2 / P-053). The lint MUST admit this.
//
// The same Refs backlink read, now threading the tenant predicate: the query carries a `TenantId`
// bound (the RLS guard / the `(tenant, target_root)` partition prefix the `edge_inbound` index
// requires), so it can only ever see one tenant's edges — there is no cross-tenant query path
// (refined-arch reference-graph §3; ID-3). This is the structurally-correct edge read.
pub async fn backlinks(pool: &PgPool, tenant_id: TenantId, target_root: &ArtifactRef) -> Vec<Edge> {
    // OK: the TenantId is threaded into the query — `(tenant, target_root)`, the edge_inbound key.
    sqlx::query(
        "SELECT source, rel FROM edge WHERE tenant = $1 AND target_root = $2 AND NOT tombstoned",
    )
    .bind(tenant_id)
    .bind(target_root.as_str())
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .expect("backlink query")
}
